messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx rate observed for /v1/generate (region: us-west1). Pager: miguel. Auto-escalation threshold crossed at 15:42 UTC.

miguel: seeing a spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts. 5xxs jumped from ~0.2% to 6% starting ~15:40. paging oncall.

jamie: on it. pulling recent rollouts and routing changes. any deploys at 15:30-15:40?

kira: no customer-facing deploys in that window from runtime, but we did push a config bump to prefix-kv TTL and compaction policy at 15:33 (PR #4821).

ashley: support reporting a customer (AcmeCorp) seeing repeated 502s and partial responses. ticket #SUP-3112 linked.

miguel: thanks. jamie, can you snapshot the proxy/error logs and kv metrics? i'll start mitigation plan.

jamie: grabbing stats now. 1) 5xx-by-code: 502s and 504s dominate. 2) backend latency: tail p95 for request to kv-store jumped from 20ms -> 480ms. 3) prefix-kv miss ratio increased and eviction rate spiked.

jamie: query run: `SELECT rate_5xx, kv_latency, eviction_rate FROM infra.metrics WHERE service='prefix-kv' AND region='us-west1' SINCE -15m`

jamie: output snippet:
```
time         rate_5xx   kv_latency_ms   eviction_per_min
15:28        0.002      18              12
15:36        0.045      220             890
15:41        0.061      480             1250
```

kira: eviction_per_min looks like an eviction storm. compaction/ttl change might've caused aggressive LRU churn. Could be cache corruption or compaction thrash.

miguel: customer impact: broad - routing shows ~12% of requests in us-west1 falling back to slow backend and causing tokenization errors in some cases. we should mitigate ASAP: plan options: A) revert TTL/compaction PR, B) disable prefix cache (fall back to direct kv reads with rate-limit), C) route traffic to us-east/warm replicas.

ashley: priority customers flagged: AcmeCorp (p99 latency spikes), Internal test harness is failing. RTO < 1h if we roll back.

jamie: quick check: config rollback will require restart of runtime pods (~2-3min per pod) and will spike CPU while cache warm-up happens. Disable prefix cache is configflag `prefix_cache.enabled=false` on the route—hot reload possible.

kira: i can toggle the feature flag for the afflicted hostpool now. Suggest disabling prefix cache for routes that have high eviction rates (prefix-index route). That should stop eviction storms and remove corrupted cache entries.

miguel: do it. jamie, prepare a script to toggle and monitor errors + canary traffic. also open a follow-up for safe rollback of PR #4821.

jamie: running flag toggle for hostpool us-west1-prefix: `./ops/feature-toggle --set prefix_cache.enabled=false --hostpool us-west1-prefix`

jamie: toggled at 15:49 UTC. propagating.

incident-bot: NOTE: configuration change recorded (#cfg-7582) by jamie at 15:49.

jamie: immediate telemetry: kv eviction rate dropping. 5xx rate trending down but still elevated.

jamie: new metric snapshot
```
time         rate_5xx   kv_latency_ms   eviction_per_min
15:50        0.038      300             430
15:55        0.018      120             95
16:00        0.007      32              20
```

miguel: good. customer impact reduced—AcmeCorp reporting improvement. Ashley, message support to update affected customers and set expectation: follow-up postmortem and timelines for full rollback.

ashley: notifying customers now. summary to customers: brief outage-like degradation, mitigation applied (disabled experimental compaction/ttl change), investigating root cause.

paul: support note: AcmeCorp confirmed services returning to normal and no data loss. asked for RCA and ETA for permanent fix.

kira: next steps: 1) reproduce locally with compaction params to validate eviction thrash and potential corruption path. 2) run consistency scan on a small sample prefix shard. 3) prepare patched compaction that respects steady-state eviction thresholds.

jamie: operational follow-ups: schedule rolling restart of runtime pods after cache flush to rehydrate cleanly, and run `kv-check` across a single shard. I'll queue job ops/kvsafe-check-1719.

miguel: handoff: i'm going offline in ~20m. jamie you'll remain POC for mitigation and initial RCA; kira will lead the applied fix for compaction; ashley will keep customer comms. tagging oncall rotation: @jamie (primary), @kira (secondary).

jamie: acknowledged. leaving a runbook note in the incident board: https://redwood/incident/1719473333 (placeholder).

incident-bot: INCIDENT: Severity lowered to SEV-3 at 16:05 UTC (service degradation mitigated).

miguel: quick timeline for the record: 15:33 config change to prefix-kv compaction/ttl PR #4821; 15:40 spike in eviction and 5xx; 15:49 feature-flag disable; 16:05 mitigation successful. Will file full postmortem and timeline.

kira: collecting heaps of heap/metrics and enabling additional KV traces for the next 48h. planning a safe revert for PR #4821 with additional safety checks.

ashley: customers updated; support queue monitoring for regressions.

paul: closing support loop for AcmeCorp after their confirmation.

miguel: thanks team. please add any missed actions to the incident board. we'll re-open if we see re-regression. :white_check_mark:
